message: Not supported: overall r=-0.01 (n=386), best lag 2d r=0.12; z>1 long-YAR 2d rule 47 trades, 53% hit, but OOS war-window hit rate 42% and Sharpe-like 0.42 - validity 0, actionability 8.2 heuristic only.
